title: OpenFilm Project 1.1.0
description: Durations are seconds. Assets are stored in the catalog; originals are referenced by URI. Semantic bounds and references are also checked by validateProject.

sceneScriptReviewReceipts.$comment: Project validation additionally requires unique suggestionId and requestId values across entries.

clipTransform.description: Visual transforms use the OpenFilm geometry contract: contain-fit source pixels into the composition frame, then scale, clockwise rotation around media center, and x/y translation in composition-frame pixels from frame center. Speed and volume are independent temporal/audio transforms.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees around the fitted media center.

x.description: Horizontal translation in composition-frame pixels; positive moves right.

y.description: Vertical translation in composition-frame pixels; positive moves down.

graphicLiteral.$comment: Literal data only. The explicit whitespace set follows ECMAScript trim; paired supplementary characters are allowed, lone surrogates are not.

graphicNodeData.$comment: Each discriminator branch restricts all property names, including the shared base, without relying on unevaluatedProperties or permissive primitive fallthrough.

graphicScene.$comment: validateGraphicScenes remains authoritative for Composition/node interval comparisons, unique IDs, total node/text and pixel budgets, UTF-16 text lengths, and PhotoDepth image/source/duration/region bindings. These cross-field and aggregate constraints are not expressible with standard JSON Schema data references.

sceneScriptReviewReceiptIdentifier.$comment: Runtime validation also requires well-formed Unicode and a maximum of 256 UTF-16 code units.

photoBezier.$comment: Runtime validation additionally requires x1 <= x2 and y1 <= y2.

titleTextRuns.$comment: Runtime validation checks splitAt against the actual safe title/cue text and a nonempty LF-separated boundary.

storyPresetRecipe.$comment: Runtime validation additionally enforces unique beat keys, default-locale text, and maxDuration >= targetDuration.

presetSnapshotFilmLook.$comment: Runtime validates canonical identity, plain text/data-only content, exact integrity hashes, per-snapshot encoded byte bounds and aggregate project snapshot budgets.

presetSnapshotTitle.$comment: Runtime validates canonical identity, plain text/data-only content, exact integrity hashes, per-snapshot encoded byte bounds and aggregate project snapshot budgets.

presetSnapshotStory.$comment: Runtime validates canonical identity, plain text/data-only content, exact integrity hashes, per-snapshot encoded byte bounds and aggregate project snapshot budgets.

captionTrack.$comment: Runtime enforces cue identity/order/time/source/text relationships, composition bounds and aggregate safe-text limits.

$comment: Schema1.1 adds inline pins and exact structural definitions for current photo/title/primary/local-preset owners. validateProject and application source/CAS/integrity owners additionally enforce cross-field constraints, encoded byte budgets, references and snapshot hashes.
